project.name: Cloud Resource Manager (aggregator)
project.description: Root aggregator. Builds all services with one command (NFR-1, NFR-6). It is NOT a parent: each service inherits spring-boot-starter-parent directly and carries its own Maven wrapper, so every service is independently buildable and runnable. Modules for U2-U4 (billing, provider, notification, usage-aggregator, expiry-worker) are added when those units are built.
